groups.sentence: The institution establishes a clear policy on what logging and auditing of AI use takes place.
Instructors clearly label and advertise assignments where AI usage logs are shared with them.
AI interactions and records could be accessed during formal misconduct investigations.
The institution may monitor AI use for compliance and risk assessment, including through periodic audits of networks and systems.
The institution reserves the right to access, review and audit prompts, outputs and other information on its AI tools.
Individual user interactions with the institution's AI tool are not monitored.
